notes.title: Just Move On! Update (v0.1.1.1)
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE (v0.1.1.1) [/b]

The new update is out, and consists of the following: -

[list]
[*] Support for [b]Xbox controllers[/b].
[*] Players can now navigate the menu and play the game using their controller.
[/list]

tags.feature: Players can now navigate the menu and play the game using their controller.
